subject: general
question: Which fort is regarded as the first pillar of the Maratha empire?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prachandagad.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• It is also known as **Torana** fort and is situated in the **Pune **district.
 
• It is regarded as the first pillar of the Maratha Empire.
 
• This fort was taken over by Shivaji from his uncle **Shambaji Mohite.** 
 
• **Maratha Empire**
 
 
• **​Last King - **Pratap Singh
 
• **Time Period - **1674-1818
 
• **Founder - **Shivaji
 
• **Capital - **Pune
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sindhudurg**

 
 
• Sindhudurg fort was built by Shivaji Maharaj on the shore of Malvan town of Sindhudurg district in the Konkan region of Maharashtra.
 
• Situated on Kurt island, it served as the Naval Headquarters of the Marathas.
 
 
 
• **Rajgad**
 
 
• **​​**It is a fort situated in the Pune district of Maharastra.
 
• It was also known as Murumdev.
 
• It served as the capital of the Maratha Empire under the rule of Chatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.
 
 
 
• **Panhala**
 
 
• ​​Panhala fort is also known as Panhalgad and Panhalla.
 
• It is situated in Panhala, 20 kilometers northwest of Kolhapur in Maharashtra.
